LESSON: PERSONAL HYGIENE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin
Topic 3.1: Personal Hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Personal Hygiene
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does personal hygiene promote good health?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify healthy practices that promote personal hygiene
2. apply healthy practices that promote personal hygiene

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Personal Hygiene

Teach
• Observe Personal Hygiene in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Personal Hygiene (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Personal Hygiene.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Personal Hygiene.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Personal Hygiene.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify healthy practices that promote personal hygiene
• apply healthy practices that promote personal hygiene

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Personal Hygiene.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Personal Hygiene: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does personal hygiene promote good health?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify healthy practices that promote personal hygiene
• apply healthy practices that promote personal hygiene

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
